pairs.subject: prompt-safety
pairs.evidence: pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_credentials.py:105 The test requires unavailable CV corroboration to produce the same empty findings list as a completed clean check, losing the required not-inspected outcome.

techniques.evidence: pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_automation_constant_sync.py:110 The surrounding test binds generated prompt limits to Python values and verifies that TypeScript re-exports them without independent declarations.
pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_prompt_budgets.py:75 Real prompt builders are tested with oversized JD, company and CV blocks, requiring class-specific ceilings and visible truncation markers.
pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_credentials.py:105 Required-licence corroboration silently skips unreadable CV text; its result cannot distinguish not inspected from inspected without findings.
pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_automation.py:1230 A model-issued early-career rejection is structurally rewritten to hold after generation, preventing that response from winning an automated rejection.
pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_prompt_fences.py:199 Breakout payloads pass through real prompt builders, and disabling marker defusing must make the same fence-integrity assertion fail.

pairs.registryProposal: Align the golden path's mandatory fresh-nonce wording with untrusted-span-fencing's explicit allowance for fixed markers stripped from every payload.
